checks.name: sqrt_abs_det_g_is_cos_z

checks.name: mixed_riemann_free_of_warp_and_a4

checks.detail: P_(4) would need GKD of 9 indices over 8 values: two equal upper indices give two equal rows of the delta matrix, determinant 0; so k = 1, 2, 3 is the full Lovelock series in 8 dimensions

checks.name: E1_divergence_free

checks.name: E3_divergence_free
checks.detail: nabla_mu E_(3)^mu_nu = 0 for nu = x1..x8 (exact; Christoffel symbols of this file)

checks.name: independent_components
checks.detail: the left-hand sides of the 64 components reduce to x1 (= x2 = x3), x4, x5 (= x6 = x7), x8 and the x4-x8 pair; every other off-diagonal left-hand side is 0, so those components read 0 = kappa T^mu_nu

checks.name: evolution_factorises_a4pp_times_F
checks.detail: sum_k alpha_k (E_(k)^x1_x1 - E_(k)^x5_x5) = a4'' F(a4'), F = 2*alpha1 - 48*ad1^2*alpha2 + 720*ad1^4*alpha3 - 80*alpha2*H^2 + 864*ad1^2*alpha3*H^2 + 720*alpha3*H^4

checks.name: evolution_F_not_identically_zero
checks.detail: F(a4') vanishes identically as a polynomial in (a4', H) only for alpha1 = alpha2 = alpha3 = 0

checks.name: algebraic_identity_x1_plus_x5_minus_2x8
checks.detail: sum_k alpha_k (E^x1_x1 + E^x5_x5 - 2 E^x8_x8) = 0 identically (each k separately), so the field equations imply p3 + p_t = 2 p8

checks.name: x8_component_contains_no_a4pp
checks.detail: the x4 (constraint) and x8 components contain a4' only (first order)

checks.name: constraint_propagation_bianchi
checks.detail: d/dx4 [sum_k alpha_k E_(k)^x4_x4] = 3 a4' sum_k alpha_k (E^x1_x1 - E^x5_x5) identically (the x4 component of the Bianchi identity): the derivative of the constraint equals 3 a4' times the evolution equation once rho' = -3 a4' (p3 - p_t)

checks.name: conservation_components
checks.detail: nabla_mu T^mu_x4 = -d4 rho - 3 a4' (p3 - p_t) + d8 q84 - 6 H tan(z) q84 and nabla_mu T^mu_x8 = d8 p8 + 3 H cot(z) (2 p8 - p3 - p_t) + d4 q48 (the other components vanish identically)

checks.name: einstein_null_energy_x8
checks.detail: Einstein: kappa (rho + p8) = -6 (a4'^2 + H^2) < 0 for every a4 and every Lambda (H > 0): the source violates the null energy condition along the null direction x4 + x8

checks.name: einstein_no_vacuum_solution
checks.detail: with T = 0 the Einstein equations (any Lambda) have no real solution a4 for H > 0: the x4 and x8 components give 36 H^2 + 2 Lambda = 0 and 6 a4'^2 + 6 H^2 = 0

checks.name: linear_member_equal_pressures
checks.detail: for a4 = A H x4 + a0 (a4'' = 0) the field equations require p3 = p_t = p8 =: p, all constant, rho constant (any alpha_k, Lambda)

checks.name: linear_member_vacuum_factor
checks.detail: sum_k alpha_k (E^x4_x4 - E^x8_x8) at a4' = A H equals 6 (A^2 + 1) H^2 V, V = alpha1 - 40*alpha2*H^2 - 8*AA^2*alpha2*H^2 + 360*alpha3*H^4 + 144*AA^2*alpha3*H^4 + 72*AA^4*alpha3*H^4; vacuum (rho = p = 0) needs V = 0

checks.name: einstein_gauss_bonnet_vacuum_linear
checks.detail: Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet (alpha1 = 1, alpha3 = 0): V = 1 - 8 alpha2 H^2 (A^2 + 5), so V = 0 gives A^2 = (1 - 40 alpha2 H^2)/(8 alpha2 H^2) (real A iff 0 < alpha2 H^2 <= 1/40), with Lambda = -sum_k alpha_k E^x4_x4

checks.name: clifford_relations_own_rep
checks.detail: the representation built here (Cl(1,1) tensor-graded four times; real 16 x 16) satisfies {gamma^a, gamma^b} = 2 eta^ab, eta = diag(1,1,1,-1,-1,-1,-1,1)

checks.name: C_properties_own_rep
checks.detail: C = gamma^x8 gamma^x1 gamma^x2 gamma^x3 is real symmetric, C^2 = 1, C gamma^a antisymmetric (the properties SPEC section 2 requires; every bilinear identity below uses only these, so it holds in the author's T16 as well)

checks.name: spin_connection_antisymmetric
checks.detail: omega_mu ab = -omega_mu ba for the canonical spin connection of this metric (vielbein postulate)

checks.name: Omega_x4_Omega_x8_vanish
checks.detail: Omega_x4 = Omega_x8 = 0 (the diagonal vielbein has no x4 component that varies, and e^x8 depends on x8 only)

checks.name: gamma_mu_anticommutes_with_Omega_mu_no_sum
checks.detail: {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} = 0 for each mu separately (no sum): the spin connection drops out of every diagonal kinetic component K^mu_mu = (1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^mu Psi)

checks.name: gravity_term_gamma_mu_Omega_mu
checks.detail: gamma^mu Omega_mu = 3 H gamma^x8 exactly (the x4 terms of the 3 inflating and 3 deflating directions cancel; the hidden-direction term survives; independent of a4 and x8)

checks.name: condensate_equation_x8_consistent
checks.detail: for Phi = Phi(x4) the equation is d4 Phi = A Phi with A = -gamma^x4 (M - 3 H gamma^x8), free of x8: an x8-independent solution exists

checks.name: condensate_S_constant
checks.detail: C A + A^T C = 0 (M real), so d4 S = d4 (Phi^dagger C Phi) = 0: S is constant along x4 (exact, for every initial Phi)

checks.name: condensate_adjoint_equation
checks.detail: (D_mu Phibar) gamma^mu = -M Phibar holds for the condensate (the adjoint of the field equation)

checks.name: condensate_kinetic_tensor_diagonal
checks.detail: for the condensate the symmetrised kinetic tensor has K^x4_x4 = M S, K^mu_mu = 0 for mu = x1..x3, x5..x8, and K^x4_x8 = K^x8_x4 = 0, exactly, for every Phi

checks.name: condensate_offdiagonal_are_three_gamma_bilinears
checks.detail: the nonzero off-diagonal kinetic components of the condensate are exactly multiples of the 15 bilinears B_abc = Phibar gamma^a gamma^b gamma^c Phi with {a,b,c} = {i, x4, x8} (i = x1..x3, x5..x7; coefficients proportional to H or a4') and {i, j, x4} (i = x1..x3, j = x5..x7; coefficients proportional to a4'); 42 ordered pairs (mu, nu) are nonzero

checks.name: condensate_einstein_quadratic_U
checks.detail: Einstein, a4 = A H x4 + a0, U = (lambda/2) S^2 (rho = sigmaT (m S + lambda S^2/2), p = sigmaT lambda S^2/2): the x4 and x8 equations are equivalent to kappa sigmaT m S = -(36 H^2 + 2 Lambda) and 6 (A^2 + 1) H^2 = -kappa sigmaT S (m + lambda S)

checks.name: condensate_diagonal_witness_exact
checks.detail: exact Gaussian-rational witnesses (M, H) = (5, 1), (5, 4/3), (-5, 1): Phi = e^{-i w x4} Phi0 with w = sqrt(M^2 - 9 H^2) = {4, 3, 4}, Phi0 = v1 + c v2 (v1, v2 the A-eigenvectors with gamma^x1 gamma^x5 = gamma^x2 gamma^x6 = gamma^x3 gamma^x7 = -1 and +1, c = conj(v1^dagger C v2)), solves the condensate equation; all 15 three-gamma bilinears and every off-diagonal kinetic component vanish for every a4, a4'; S = {204800, 115200, 204800} != 0
